newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Parliament started debate on the opposition's first of two confidence motions against the government of Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
The motion accuses the government of failing to fulfil provisions of its programme and election promises.
* The local leu currency's depreciation against the dollar will be 100 percent for the whole year, Victor Ciorbea told the joint session of parliament's chambers.

* MPs of the leftist opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) demanded that the government step down and said their economic policy has only caused a dramatic drop in living standards and increased taxation.
* The ruling coalition has intensified its political purges, PDSR deputy Rodica Stanoiu told parliament.
* Turkey will lobby NATO to include Romania in the first wave of expansion, Turkish Defence Minister Turhan Tayan said after meeting his Romanian opposite number, Victor Babiuc.
